g.title: TF_WFRT_SIGN_REQUESTS
g.text: E-Signature Requests - This entity includes all e-Signature packages created/initialized by a Workflow Process.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: TF_WFRT_SIGN_REQUEST_SIGNERS
g.text: E-Signature Signers - This entity aggregates information about individuals who have been invited to sign one or more documents (for ex. contact data).
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: TF_WFRT_SIGNREQ_DOCUMENTS
g.text: E-Signature Documents - This entity includes the name of the documents included in the same E-Signature request.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created

g.title: TF_WFRT_SIGNREQ_INTEROPS
g.text: E-Signature Runtime Logs - This entity includes the reference to the interop runtimes that where created to get the signature. For the same request, more than one record can exist in case of reminders sent.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
